name: refrigeration_screw_compressor_r22
title: Screw compressor in an R22 refrigeration cycle (full load / part load)
summary: Reference model of a volumetric screw compressor with internal leakage through an opening (isentropic nozzle + diffuser), closing a simple R22 cycle; part load by the sliding valve, with pumping and constant losses.

verification.reference: EES stored solution of the source file (121 numeric variables compared; reference converted from kPa/kJ to SI), part-load point X_sv = 0.4105; full-load cross-check against the solution pasted in a comment of the original file
verification.notes: compare_solution.py: 121 common variables, 71 differ (rtol=0.001). 31 absolute h/s variables carry the EES 6.395 vs CoolProp R22 reference-state offset (not comparable; differences agree to 0.24 %); max rel diff of the 90 others 1.34e-2 (t_su1), propagated from the 0.15 % R22 saturation-pressure difference. Full-load cross-check: COP_c 4.496/4.506, Q_dot_ev 683.7/684.7 kW.
